observation.happening: Meeting notes document with hierarchical structure: title with metadata (duration/attendees), summary, structured decisions (with bracketed references), action items, and full transcript with speaker attribution and timestamps.
observation.most_important: Exceptional information hierarchy: summary → decisions (linked with [1], [2]) → action items (linked with [3], [4], [5]) → full transcript. Bracketed numbers create traceability from action items back to transcript moments.
observation.next_action: Review summary, track action items by owner, click into transcript at specific timestamps, or add collaborative notes.

705A.why: Exceptional design execution. Hierarchy is crystal-clear: progressive disclosure from summary through decisions/actions to detail. Bracketed reference numbers linking actions to transcript timestamps show thoughtful, intentional design for traceability. Typography scales appropriately. Geometry uses whitespace effectively without clutter. No AI-generated feel—this is skilled, purposeful UX.
